nodes.description: Public total token supply state variable of EIP20Interface.
Mapping of address to token balance in the EVM token contract.
Public nested mapping of owner to spender to remaining allowance.
Constant private MAX_UINT256 = 2**256 - 1 used as infinite-allowance sentinel.
Public token name string, 'EVAREIUM'.
Public token symbol string, 'EVM'.
Public constant uint8 decimals = 18.
Constructor of EVM: sets totalSupply to 150 million with decimals and credits all tokens to msg.sender.
Public transfer: subtracts _value from msg.sender balance and adds it to _to, emitting Transfer.
Public transferFrom: checks balance and allowance of _from for msg.sender, moves tokens and decrements allowance unless MAX_UINT256.
Public view returning the balance of _owner from the balances mapping.
Public approve: sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
Public view returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Public increaseApproval: adds _addedValue to allowed[msg.sender][_spender] using SafeMath.
Public decreaseApproval: subtracts _subtractedValue from allowance, zeroing it if the subtraction would underflow.
Library function multiplying two uint256 with overflow assertion.
Library function performing integer division.
Library function subtracting with underflow assertion.
Library function adding with overflow assertion.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and spender key.
Arithmetic and state writes in transfer: balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) and balances[_to].add(_value).
Arithmetic, require check and allowance decrement in transferFrom.
Addition to allowed[msg.sender][_spender] in increaseApproval.
Conditional subtraction/zeroing of allowance in decreaseApproval.
Parameter _to of transfer (recipient address).
Parameter _value of transfer (amount to send).
Parameter _from of transferFrom (source address).
Parameter _to of transferFrom (recipient address).
Parameter _value of transferFrom (amount to move).
Parameter _owner of balanceOf.
Parameter _spender of approve.
Parameter _value of approve (allowance amount).
Parameter _owner of allowance.
Parameter _spender of allowance.
Parameter _spender of increaseApproval.
Parameter _addedValue of increaseApproval.
Parameter _spender of decreaseApproval.
Parameter _subtractedValue of decreaseApproval.
Local uint256 allowance = allowed[_from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
Local uint256 oldValue caching the current allowance inside decreaseApproval.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the totalSupply state variable (150 * 10**6 * 10**decimals).
Constructor directly assigns balances[msg.sender] = totalSupply, granting all initial tokens to the caller.
msg.sender is used as the key/owner for the balances mapping in the constructor and transfer.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve, transferFrom, increaseApproval and decreaseApproval.
transfer executes the SafeMath sub/add balance arithmetic block.
transfer writes the balances mapping for msg.sender and _to.
transferFrom executes the require check plus SafeMath sub/add arithmetic block.
transferFrom writes the balances mapping for _from and _to.
transferFrom reads and conditionally decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
increaseApproval performs SafeMath add on the allowance.
increaseApproval writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
decreaseApproval performs the conditional subtraction or zeroing of the allowance.
decreaseApproval writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
approve sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
allowance reads allowed[_owner][_spender].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
_value is subtracted from the sender balance and added to the recipient balance.
_to is used as the recipient key credited in the balances mapping.
_from is used for the balance require check and allowance lookup.
_to of transferFrom is credited in the balances mapping.
_value drives the balance require check and subtraction/allowance decrement in transferFrom.
Local allowance cached from allowed is compared against _value and decremented against MAX_UINT256.
_spender is the second key when approve writes the allowed mapping.
_value is stored as the approved allowance amount.
_owner is the first key read by allowance.
_spender is the second key read by allowance.
_spender selects the allowance entry modified by increaseApproval.
_addedValue is added to the existing allowance.
_spender selects the allowance entry modified by decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue is compared with oldValue and subtracted from the allowance.
Local oldValue is read to decide between zeroing and subtracting the allowance.
_owner is used to look up balances[_owner] in balanceOf.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to only feeds the balance update inside transfer's unsafe arithmetic block.
Parameter _value only feeds the SafeMath sub/add operations of transfer.
Parameter _from only feeds the require check and balance/allowance updates of transferFrom.
Parameter _to of transferFrom only feeds the recipient balance update.
Parameter _value of transferFrom only feeds the checked arithmetic and allowance decrement.
Parameter _owner is used solely as the lookup key in balanceOf.
Parameter _spender is used solely as the allowance key set by approve.
Parameter _value is used solely as the allowance value stored by approve.
Parameter _owner is used solely as the first lookup key in allowance.
Parameter _spender is used solely as the second lookup key in allowance.
Parameter _spender selects the allowance entry updated by increaseApproval.
Parameter _addedValue only feeds the addition to the allowance in increaseApproval.
Parameter _spender selects the allowance entry updated by decreaseApproval.
Parameter _subtractedValue only feeds the branch and subtraction in decreaseApproval.
Local allowance is a cached read of allowed used only inside transferFrom's logic.
Local oldValue is a cached read of the allowance used only inside decreaseApproval.
